questions.question: What number comes next in the pattern: 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
questions.explanation: Each number doubles: 16 x 2 = 32.

questions.question: If all roses are flowers and some flowers fade quickly, which statement must be true?
questions.explanation: Only some flowers fade quickly, so some roses may be among them, but it is not guaranteed for all roses.

questions.question: A train leaves Stockholm at 10:00 and travels for 2 hours and 45 minutes. What time does it arrive?
questions.explanation: 10:00 plus 2 hours is 12:00, plus 45 minutes is 12:45.

questions.question: Which word does not belong: apple, banana, carrot, cherry?
questions.explanation: Carrot is a vegetable, while the others are fruits.

questions.question: Complete the sequence: 3, 6, 11, 18, ?
questions.explanation: The differences increase by 2 each time: +3, +5, +7, +9. So 18 + 9 = 27.

questions.question: If five machines make five items in five minutes, how long would 100 machines take to make 100 items?
questions.explanation: Each machine makes one item in five minutes, so 100 machines make 100 items in five minutes.

questions.question: Which shape completes the pattern: circle, square, triangle, circle, square, ?
questions.explanation: The repeating pattern is circle, square, triangle.

questions.question: A shop gives 20% off a 500 kr jacket. What is the new price?
Which number is the odd one out: 9, 16, 25, 30, 36?
questions.explanation: 9, 16, 25, and 36 are square numbers. 30 is not.

questions.question: If today is Wednesday, what day will it be in 17 days?
questions.explanation: 17 days is two full weeks plus 3 days. Wednesday plus 3 days is Saturday.

questions.question: A scientist discovers a door at the bottom of the ocean that opens only during a thunderstorm. What is the best opening for a story?
answers: The door had been waiting for the storm.
The ocean was cold and deep.
questions.explanation: It creates mystery, tension, and immediately makes the reader want to know what is behind the door.

questions.question: Which idea is the most imaginative use for an old railway carriage?
answers: Turn it into a mobile library
questions.explanation: A mobile library gives the carriage a new purpose and creates an interesting story setting.

questions.question: Your character finds a note that says: “Do not trust the person who gave you this.” What should happen next for the strongest story?
answers: The character immediately throws the note away and nothing happens.
The character tries to find out who wrote the note.
The character forgets about the note.
The character reads the note again but ignores it.
questions.explanation: Investigating the note creates conflict, suspense, and a reason for the story to move forward.

questions.question: Which title fits a story about a city where memories can be traded?
questions.explanation: The title directly suggests the central imaginative idea of the story.

questions.question: A robot begins dreaming about the ocean, although it has never seen one. What is the most interesting explanation?
answers: Its creator implanted memories from someone else.
The ocean is made of water.
questions.explanation: This creates a mystery about identity, memory, and the robot's origin.

questions.question: Which ending is most surprising but still makes sense for a story about a missing cat?
answers: The cat had been living in the neighbour’s greenhouse and had kittens.
The cat disappeared forever with no explanation.
The cat was never mentioned again.
questions.explanation: It is unexpected, but it explains where the cat was and gives the story an emotional payoff.

questions.question: Which setting would create the strongest contrast for a happy festival?
questions.explanation: A happy festival in an abandoned space station creates an unusual contrast and makes the setting more memorable.

questions.question: Which character flaw would create the most interesting conflict for a brilliant inventor?
answers: They cannot admit when they are wrong
questions.explanation: Refusing to admit mistakes can lead to bigger problems and gives the character room to grow.

questions.question: A map shows a road that changes location every night. What is the best next story question?
answers: Who or what moves the road, and why?
What material is the road made of?
questions.explanation: It focuses on the central mystery and gives the story a clear direction.

questions.question: Which opening line creates the most curiosity?
answers: On the day the moon stopped moving, everyone pretended nothing had changed.
I woke up and ate breakfast.
questions.explanation: It introduces an impossible event immediately and makes the reader ask what will happen next.
